children: Gold rises in early Asian trade. Prices are supported by longer-term fundamentals, says Peter A. Grant, vice president and senior metals strategist at Zaner Metals, in a note. This is driven by persistent central bank buying, rising geopolitical risks and concerns over fiscal sustainability and currency debasement. He says these structural drivers are also complemented by the seasonal period extending into February. Spot gold is 0.5% higher at $4,365.58 an ounce. (amanda.lee@wsj.com)
